answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a per-identity stake bond slashed and burned before any reward pays out. To farm attestations an attacker must lock real capital per key and risk forfeiture when a colluding pair is flagged, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand bonds, not one script. Payouts clear only after an identity crosses a horizon of verified history; the bond is the bridge from untrusted to trusted. A forged cluster stays below that zenith while paying full price per seat, so expected loss grows faster than any sybil yield.
